question: A can finish a work in 12 days and B can finish it in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
solution: A's 1 day work = 1/12, B's = 1/24. Together = 1/12 + 1/24 = 3/24 = 1/8. So 8 days.

expected_steps.intro_speech: Let's see how the two work rates fit together.

steps.label: Step 1: One day work
steps.speech: A takes 12 days for the whole job, so that's one twelfth each day. B takes 24 days, so that's one twenty-fourth. Those are their daily shares.

steps.label: Step 2: Together
steps.speech: Since they're working together, their daily shares add up. A's one twelfth is two twenty-fourths; add B's one twenty-fourth and that's three twenty-fourths, or one eighth per day.

steps.label: Step 3: Days
steps.speech: So they get through one eighth of the job each day. The whole thing takes eight days—that's option B.

tip.display: Together rate = sum of individual rates
tip.speech: When people work at the same time, their daily work rates add together.

expected_steps.answer_speech: So, eight days together. That's option B.
